options.text: Adjusts to the current prime rate at every monthly payment
Can adjust based on an index plus margin, subject to caps
Changes only when the borrower refinances into a new loan
Adjusts based on the lender's margin alone, with no rate caps

explanation: ARMs adjust with index + margin within contractual caps.

distractorExplanations.a: ARMs adjust at set intervals using a chosen index plus margin; no rule ties them to prime monthly.
distractorExplanations.c: Describes a fixed-rate loan replaced by refinancing; an ARM rate adjusts within the same loan.
distractorExplanations.d: The margin is fixed; adjustments follow the index, and most ARMs carry periodic and lifetime caps.

prompt: Title insurance primarily protects against

options.text: Lender losses if the borrower defaults with less than 20% equity
Fire and storm damage to the structure during ownership
Covered title defects and claims against ownership per the policy
Defects in title arising after the policy date, like new liens

prompt: A debit to the buyer on a closing statement means:

The buyer is charged; it increases cash needed

prompt: The secondary mortgage market's main function is to:

prompt: Ana is moving to Denver to start a real estate career. Based on what she read about other states, she plans to get a salesperson license first and upgrade later. What should she know about Colorado licensing?

options.text: She must hold a salesperson license before she can apply as a broker
She needs a transaction-broker license to work with buyers and sellers
Colorado issues broker licenses and has no salesperson tier
She may practice under her employing broker's license for a year

explanation: The Colorado Real Estate Commission licenses brokers and has no separate salesperson license, so Ana applies for a broker license and works under an employing broker. Transaction-broker is a type of brokerage relationship with a consumer, not a license category anyone applies for.

distractorExplanations.a: Confuses Colorado with states that use a two-tier salesperson and broker system. Colorado has a single broker license.
distractorExplanations.b: Transaction-broker describes the working relationship with a consumer; it is not a license class issued by the Commission.
distractorExplanations.d: Anyone performing brokerage for others for a fee needs a license in her own name; working under another's license is unlicensed activity.
